en.name: Innocent XIII
en.summary: A short-reigning, chronically ill pope whose pontificate was largely consumed by disputes over the Jesuit order's China missions.
en.body: Michelangelo dei Conti's health was already failing at his election, limiting his three-year pontificate's scope, though he continued his predecessors' scrutiny of Jesuit missionary practices in China and briefly threatened to suppress the order's privileges there before his death.
